title: carya pallida var. arenicola
intro: Carya pallida var. arenicola, commonly known as the sand hickory, is a plant species belonging to the Juglandaceae family, closely related to other hickory trees. The health benefits of Carya pallida var. arenicola include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function due to its rich content of antioxidants and other bioactive compounds. The plant has therapeutic actions that may aid in the management of various conditions, such as pain relief, fever reduction, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Carya pallida var. arenicola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
